name: Sled Push
steps: Stand behind the sled with your hands on its poles, feet staggered and torso angled forward.
Brace your trunk and hold your arms steady as you lean into the poles.
Drive powerfully forward by taking strong, alternating strides, pushing fully through the balls of your feet and extending your hips and knees.
Keep your head neutral and drive continuously across the target distance until bringing the sled to a controlled stop.
tips: Maintain a straight diagonal line from your head to your pushing heel rather than rounding your lower back.
Drive your knees smoothly forward like sprinting uphill without bouncing your torso vertically.
